info.name: VTex Get Product by external ID,  SKU ID, SKU external ID or slug

params.name: param
params.description: This part of the path must follow this format: `{param}={value}`. Replace `{param}` with the name of the parameter used to fetch a product, which can be one of the following: `external-id` (product reference unique identifier number in the store), `sku-id` (SKU unique identifier number), `sku-external-id` (SKU reference unique identifier number in the store) or `slug` (reference of the product in the URL of the store). Replace `{value}` with the value of the selected param. Make sure there is a `=` between them.

info.name: VTex Create product with category and brand

items.docs:
This endpoint allows two types of request:

**Type 1:** Creating a new product as well as a new category path (including subcategories) and a new brand by using `CategoryPath` and `BrandName` parameters.

**Type 2:** Creating a new product given an existing `BrandId` and an existing `CategoryId`.
